name: fix_php_foreach_reference_alias
description: Fixes the classic PHP dangling foreach-reference bug that corrupts the last element of an array
prompts: Normalizer::process in src/Normalizer.php should trim every value in the input array and then return a new list where each trimmed value is labeled with its 1-based position, like '1:apple'. It's broken by the classic PHP foreach-by-reference trap: the first loop uses `foreach ($items as &$item)` and never unsets $item afterward, so $item stays a reference to the LAST element; the second `foreach ($items as ... $item)` then reassigns that reference on each iteration, corrupting the last element (it ends up equal to the second-to-last). Fix process so the trimmed values are correct and each is labeled with its true 1-based index. Keep the class name and the process(array $items): array signature.

setup_files.src/Normalizer.php:
<?php
namespace App;

class Normalizer
{
    // Trim each value, then label it with its 1-based position: '1:apple'.
    // BUG: the first loop leaves $item as a dangling reference to the last
    // element, and the second foreach then overwrites that element each
    // iteration, corrupting the final entry.
    public function process(array $items): array
    {
        foreach ($items as &$item) {
            $item = trim($item);
        }
        $labeled = [];
        foreach ($items as $i => $item) {
            $labeled[] = ($i + 1) . ':' . $item;
        }
        return $labeled;
    }
}

test_setup_files.tests/NormalizerTest.php:
<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

require_once __DIR__ . '/../src/Normalizer.php';

final class NormalizerTest extends TestCase
{
    public function testTrimsAndLabels(): void
    {
        $out = (new \App\Normalizer())->process(['apple ', ' bee', ' cat ']);
        $this->assertSame(['1:apple', '2:bee', '3:cat'], $out);
    }

    public function testLastElementNotCorrupted(): void
    {
        $out = (new \App\Normalizer())->process(['x', 'y', 'z']);
        $this->assertSame(['1:x', '2:y', '3:z'], $out);
    }

    public function testSingleElement(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(['1:solo'], (new \App\Normalizer())->process([' solo ']));
    }
}

namespace App;

class Normalizer
{
    // Trim by key (no lingering reference), then label with the 1-based index.
    public function process(array $items): array
    {
        foreach ($items as $key => $value) {
            $items[$key] = trim($value);
        }
        $labeled = [];
        foreach ($items as $i => $item) {
            $labeled[] = ($i + 1) . ':' . $item;
        }
        return $labeled;
    }
}
